title: Risk-Aware Output Control Should be the Focus of Machine Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35052v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Well-documented failure modes of machine learning (ML) systems, including bias, toxicity, hallucination, and leakage of sensitive information, has driven the rise of machine unlearning (MU). Most existing work, however, targets parameter-space indistinguishability, seeking unlearned models that are as close as possible to models retrained from scratch on retained data. In this paper, we argue that this objective is misaligned with practical and user-relevant concerns: MU should prioritize statistically guaranteed output-space control rather than parameter-space similarity. We contend that output control with statistical guarantees is the operationally meaningful notion of unlearning, as it supports rigorous and robust objectives, scales to modern deployment settings, and enables interpretable guarantees. translated_title: 风险感知的输出控制应成为机器遗忘的核心焦点
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）系统中有据可查的失效模式，包括偏见、毒性、幻觉以及敏感信息泄露，推动了机器遗忘（MU）的兴起。然而，现有工作大多以参数空间的不可区分性为目标，追求遗忘后的模型与在保留数据上从头重新训练的模型尽可能接近。在本文中，我们认为这一目标与实际及用户相关的关注点并不一致：机器遗忘应优先考虑具有统计保证的输出空间控制，而非参数空间的相似性。我们主张，带有统计保证的输出控制才是操作上有意义的遗忘概念，因为它支持严格且稳健的目标，能够扩展到现代部署场景，并可提供可解释的保证。我们通过实证证据以及最近的理论结果来佐证这一立场，尽管这些结果最初并非以此形式提出。
tldr: 本文主张机器遗忘应摒弃以参数空间相似性为目标的传统范式，转而聚焦于具有统计保证的风险感知输出控制，因为这才是操作上有意义、可扩展且可解释的遗忘概念。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that machine unlearning should shift away from parameter-space indistinguishability and instead focus on risk-aware output control with statistical guarantees, as this is the operationally meaningful, scalable, and interpretable notion of unlearning.
